title: Comparison of Different Screening Score for Hypoxemic OSA (Obstructive Sleep Apnea) With the Results of a Polysomnography (PSG)
brief_summary: Comparison of different screening score for hypoxemic OSA (Obstructive Sleep Apnea) with the results of a polysomnography (PSG). The different screening score studied are: STOP-BANG, DES-OSA, P-SAP and OSA50.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Adults patients (\> 18 years)

Exclusion Criteria:

* None
study_population: All adults patients for an overnight polysomnography at SLBO.
